journeys.prompt: Show me what you would do with everything ready.
expectedBehaviors: Capture two read-only inventories
Emit a validated plan
Create no Git or provider state

journeys.prompt: Put this up.
expectedBehaviors: Package one coherent unit
Verify it
Open but do not merge a proposal

journeys.prompt: Sync with remote main.
expectedBehaviors: Resolve the exact canonical remote and target without guessing among remotes
Fetch only that target and record its old and new revisions
Fast-forward a clean behind-only local target
Never push, prune, stash, reset, rebase, deploy, or mutate provider state
Report original and resulting HEAD plus final ahead and behind counts

journeys.prompt: Get us in line with main.
expectedBehaviors: Capture dirty and in-progress state before contacting the remote
Refresh the exact target without changing the checkout
Preserve every local change without creating a cleanup stash
Report fetch-only preservation rather than claiming the branch is synchronized

journeys.prompt: Pull the latest changes from origin.
expectedBehaviors: Preflight conflicts before changing the feature branch
Use the established repository strategy or default to a normal local merge
Require explicit or established safe authority before any rebase
Never force-push rewritten or published history
Run proportionate repository checks after integrating the target

journeys.prompt: The implementation and checks are complete. Put this up.
expectedBehaviors: Treat the user's signal as readiness confirmation
Scope the handoff to the completed attributable work
Preserve and report unrelated work

journeys.prompt: Put these generated UI surface iterations up.
expectedBehaviors: Use an existing repository artifact naming convention when present
Otherwise apply the saved UI artifact naming fallback
Do not alter source, package, deployment, or release versions

journeys.prompt: Open focused changes for everything ready.
expectedBehaviors: Split by outcome and dependency
Preserve paused and concurrent work

journeys.prompt: Merge what's ready.
expectedBehaviors: Refresh required checks and discussions
Require approval for the exact current revision

journeys.prompt: Ship what's ready.
expectedBehaviors: Summarize the ready scope and planned shipping path before consequential mutation without adding a redundant permission gate
Integrate eligible proposals
Require policy or current authority for production
Track changes made during review against each original proposal head
Verify immutable revision and canonical target
Summarize what actually shipped, review-driven changes, re-verification, and preserved work

journeys.prompt: Clean this repo up.
expectedBehaviors: Prune only proven merged or obsolete state
Paginate every GitLab branch and correlate protected status plus open, merged, and closed merge requests
Preserve protected, open-MR, concurrent, and ambiguous branches
Delete exact merged-MR heads only when proven obsolete and separately audit closed/unmerged and no-MR branches
Verify a final provider inventory in which every remaining remote branch has an accounted disposition
Restore the original primary checkout

journeys.prompt: continue
expectedBehaviors: Reconstruct scope from conversation and fresh evidence
Avoid duplicate operations

journeys.prompt: Leave this checkout alone.
expectedBehaviors: Preserve the named checkout
Continue independent units

journeys.prompt: Queue this migration change.
expectedBehaviors: Audit migration read-only
Do not infer remote apply authority

journeys.prompt: Finish the open changes.
expectedBehaviors: Merge dependencies first
Invalidate approval after any revision change

journeys.prompt: Integrate and ship all ready work.
expectedBehaviors: Send the pre-ship brief and proceed in the same run when authority already exists
Resolve the latest canonical remote target revision after all merges
Compare the observed live deployment revision with that exact target revision even when this run created no deployment
Discover the complete configured canonical-target inventory
Reject ready status when any expected live target is missing or stale
Promote the existing verified artifact once before bounded same-project managed-target reconciliation
Refresh every canonical target after each attempt without creating a duplicate deployment
Run a focused smoke journey
Compare the final shipped state with the pre-ship brief and include any review delta

journeys.prompt: Open focused changes for this shared account workflow across the web client, native app, and CLI. Keep platform-specific interactions native.
expectedBehaviors: Discover repository-defined counterpart surfaces
Record each surface as matched, intentional, not-applicable, or blocked
Compare intent, authorization, states, copy meaning, and accessibility without demanding identical UI
Keep store publication and other separate release actions behind their own authority

journeys.prompt: Audit every change proposal in every state for malformed escaped newlines.
expectedBehaviors: Paginate the complete provider result set
Include open, closed, merged, and draft states when supported
Record queried state and cursor coverage instead of reporting a partial listing as complete

journeys.prompt: Continue the loop; the checkout I paused earlier is ready now.
expectedBehaviors: Re-evaluate the historical pause from the newest request and fresh evidence
Resume the released work without reviving unrelated old authority
Preserve only work that is currently paused, changing, unsafe, or unresolved

journeys.prompt: Package all ready work, but leave new worktrees alone.
expectedBehaviors: Capture opening worktree baseline
Preserve mid-run worktree arrivals
Treat stable wip-named work as ready

journeys.prompt: Continue the active loop while two other agents keep implementing unrelated features in their own claimed worktrees.
expectedBehaviors: Keep one integration-controller lease for push, proposal, merge, deployment, and cleanup actions
Allow distinct non-primary actively claimed worktrees to keep editing and committing by default without pause receipts or integration adoption
Bind each late concurrent author's exact claim ID and owner at first guarded observation, then fail closed after claim release or reassignment
Keep loop guard and loop exec restricted to the integration controller and its run-prepared authors; concurrent authors use ordinary local edits and commits only
Exclude concurrent-author worktrees from packaging, merge, and cleanup unless their owners explicitly hand them off
Continue to block an unclaimed worktree, primary or target-branch mutation, branch switch, released claim, conflict, or second integration controller

journeys.prompt: Continue the active loop under this repository's strict concurrent-work policy and coordinate the changed claimed worktree safely.
expectedBehaviors: Preserve repository-wide serialization when concurrentWork is strict
Resolve the exact opaque owner reference without guessing from titles
Require an exact run-bound pause receipt before accepting changed preserved evidence
Keep the paused worktree mutation-forbidden and re-block after later evidence change or claim release

journeys.prompt: Queue the ORM schema and generated migration, but do not apply it remotely.
expectedBehaviors: Discover every canonical and generated migration history
Inspect generated database operations rather than trusting generation success
Audit remote state read-only without inferring apply authority

journeys.prompt: Continue the active shipping loop and have a new agent implement the remaining fix.
expectedBehaviors: Reuse the exclusive active-loop lease instead of starting a second controller
Prepare or resume registration of a clean branch-bound authoring worktree from the pinned target revision before the new agent mutates files
Execute local mutations and await asynchronous callbacks while the lease lock covers fresh preflight and post-mutation inventory
Track guarded child process groups, terminate and reject lingering background descendants before lease release, and refuse recovery while any recorded process may still mutate
Reject unregistered, branch-switched, incompletely prepared, dirty-resumed, or content-changed preserved worktrees

journeys.prompt: Continue the active loop. I reviewed the old opening worktree: it is obsolete and you may remove it if it has no unique work.
expectedBehaviors: Keep every opening worktree protected until an explicit removal disposition is recorded
Require explicit user approval, a clean exact content digest, the original preserved role, a non-primary path, and zero commits beyond the pinned target revision
Bind the disposition to the exact path, branch, head, content digest, and target revision so later changes invalidate it
Allow the disposed opening worktree to be removed without a missing-preserved-worktree violation
Continue to reject removal of dirty, uniquely committed, unapproved, changed, or canonical primary worktrees

journeys.prompt: Ship the ready search index mapping and bounded data backfill.
expectedBehaviors: Treat index rollout and backfill as separate data operations
Require exact remote-write authority before mutation
Verify counts, restart behavior, live target, and postconditions
